### [`clear_slot_name`](../../../../src/storage/storage_scripts_251c.asm#L7) `$2521-$2529`

*data*

<a id="start_name_entry"></a>
### [`start_name_entry`](../../../../src/storage/storage_scripts_251c.asm#L11) `$252A-$2535`
